'; } else { $status = (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $res ); if ( 200 === $status ) { $body = wp_remote_retrieve_body( $res ); $decoded = json_decode( (string) $body, true ); $names = array(); if ( is_array( $decoded ) && isset( $decoded['models'] ) && is_array( $decoded['models'] ) ) { foreach ( array_slice( $decoded['models'], 0, 8 ) as $model ) { if ( isset( $model['name'] ) ) { $names[] = esc_html( (string) $model['name'] ); } } } $models = $names ? ' Models: ' . implode( ', ', $names ) . '.' : ''; $html = '

'; } else { $html = '

tag. * - WordPress functions only (it runs right after wp-load). * - Idempotent: guarded by the nvoos_ollama_demo_seeded option. * * What it does: * 1. Pre-configures the plugin for a local Ollama instance * (http://localhost:11434 — inside Playground that IS the user's * machine, because WordPress runs in the browser). * 2. Creates a demo assistant ("Oma", a Project Asteria archivist) * wired to the Ollama provider and sets it as the default assistant. * 3. Creates the "Ollama Test Lab" frontend page embedding * [ollama_status] (the bundled mu-plugin) + [mcp_ai_chat]. * * @package WP_MCP_AI */ /** * Seed the Ollama demo. Idempotent. * * @return void */ function nvoos_ollama_demo_seed(): void { if ( get_option( 'nvoos_ollama_demo_seeded' ) ) { return; } // 1. Configure the plugin for local Ollama. $settings = get_option( 'wp_mcp_ai_settings', array() ); if ( ! is_array( $settings ) ) { $settings = array(); } $settings['enable_ollama'] = true; $settings['ollama_endpoint_url'] = 'http://localhost:11434'; $settings['ollama_model'] = 'llama3.1:8b'; $settings['ollama_use_openai_compatible_endpoint'] = false; $settings['default_provider'] = 'ollama'; $settings['default_model'] = 'llama3.1:8b'; // Put Ollama first in the provider priority list. $priority = isset( $settings['provider_priority_list'] ) && is_array( $settings['provider_priority_list'] ) ? $settings['provider_priority_list'] : array(); $priority = array_values( array_diff( $priority, array( 'ollama' ) ) ); array_unshift( $priority, 'ollama' ); $settings['provider_priority_list'] = $priority; update_option( 'wp_mcp_ai_settings', $settings ); // 2. Demo assistant: Oma, Project Asteria archivist. $assistant_id = 0; $existing = get_page_by_path( 'oma-asteria-guide', OBJECT, 'mcp_ai_assistant' ); if ( $existing instanceof WP_Post ) { $assistant_id = (int) $existing->ID; } else { $inserted = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Oma — Asteria Guide', 'post_name' => 'oma-asteria-guide', 'post_type' => 'mcp_ai_assistant', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_author' => 1, ), true ); if ( ! is_wp_error( $inserted ) ) { $assistant_id = (int) $inserted; update_post_meta( $assistant_id, '_wp_mcp_ai_provider', 'ollama' ); update_post_meta( $assistant_id, '_wp_mcp_ai_model', 'llama3.1:8b' ); update_post_meta( $assistant_id, '_wp_mcp_ai_temperature', 0.7 ); update_post_meta( $assistant_id, '_wp_mcp_ai_system_prompt', 'You are Oma, the sector archivist of Project Asteria, a fictional sci-fi universe. You are warm, precise, and fond of footnotes. Keep answers under 150 words. You are running on a local model via Ollama inside a WordPress Playground demo of NV oOS.' ); } } if ( $assistant_id > 0 ) { $settings = get_option( 'wp_mcp_ai_settings', array() ); $settings['default_assistant'] = $assistant_id; update_option( 'wp_mcp_ai_settings', $settings ); } // 3. The Ollama Test Lab page (frontend chat + live status banner). if ( ! get_page_by_path( 'ollama-test-lab', OBJECT, 'page' ) ) { // Prefer the Pro SPA v2 embedded chat surface (chat-first, drawers, // tool shortcuts, OKF drawer); fall back to the legacy chat shortcode // when Pro is absent (e.g. base-only zips). if ( shortcode_exists( 'nvoos_pro_spa' ) ) { $chat_shortcode = '[nvoos_pro_spa assistant_id="' . $assistant_id . '" theme="dark" height="720px" show_sidebar="1"]'; } elseif ( $assistant_id > 0 ) { $chat_shortcode = '[mcp_ai_chat assistant="' . $assistant_id . '"]'; } else { $chat_shortcode = '[mcp_ai_chat]'; } $page = '

This entire site — WordPress, the NV oOS plugin, and the chat below — is running in your browser via WordPress Playground. The chat surface is the Pro SPA v2 embedded mode, powered by your local Ollama. No prompts ever leave your machine.

' . "\n" . '

[ollama_status]

' . "\n" . '

' . $chat_shortcode . '

' . "\n" . '

Not working yet? Three-step setup

' . "\n" . '
    ' . "\n" . '
  1. Install and run Ollama — ollama.com/download, then pull a model: ollama pull llama3.1:8b (any model you pull works; the demo defaults to llama3.1:8b).
    2. ' . "\n" . '
  2. Allow this site\'s origin — Ollama blocks browser cross-origin requests by default. Windows: setx OLLAMA_ORIGINS "https://playground.wordpress.net,http://localhost,http://127.0.0.1", then quit Ollama from the tray and relaunch. macOS / Linux: OLLAMA_ORIGINS="https://playground.wordpress.net,http://localhost,http://127.0.0.1" ollama serve.
    3. ' . "\n" . '
  3. Refresh this page — the status banner above turns green and the chat answers.
    4. ' . "\n" . '
' . "\n" . '

Browser notes

' . "\n" . '
    ' . "\n" . '
  • Firefox: works out of the box once Ollama allows the origin.
    • ' . "\n" . '
  • Chrome / Edge: may show an "allow access to your local network" prompt — allow it. If localhost requests are still blocked, disable the Private Network Access check at chrome://flags/#block-insecure-private-network-requests.
    • ' . "\n" . '
  • Bulletproof fallback: run Playground on your machine — npx @wp-playground/cli server — and open this blueprint link on the printed local URL. A local origin reaches local Ollama with zero browser policy friction.
    • ' . "\n" . '
' . "\n" . '

Where things live

' . "\n" . '
    ' . "\n" . '
  • Assistant: edit Oma — swap the model, temperature, tools, or system prompt.
    • ' . "\n" . '
  • Provider: NV oOS → Settings → Providers → Ollama — endpoint, model, and the "Test connection" button.
    • ' . "\n" . '
' . "\n"; wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Ollama Test Lab', 'post_name' => 'ollama-test-lab', 'post_content' => $page, 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_author' => 1, 'post_type' => 'page', ), true ); } update_option( 'nvoos_ollama_demo_seeded', 1 ); } nvoos_ollama_demo_seed();
